p022.lead: Seven orders of Sons who enter superuniverse service through the Trinity embrace, in a paper that shows why experience is a qualification nothing else can replace.

p022.foot.text: Narrated by a Mighty Messenger of the revelatory corps of Orvonton

p022.s0.h: Introduction — The Third Group of the Sons of God
p022.s0.b0: If Papers 20 and 21 dealt with the descending Sons, Paper 22 introduces the third group, the **Trinitized Sons of God**. By origin they fall into three divisions: Deity-trinitized Sons, Trinity-embraced Sons, and Creature-trinitized Sons. The Deity-trinitized Sons are not revealed in these narratives, so the paper is devoted to the other two, and especially to the Trinity-embraced sons.

p022.s0.b2: What the three divisions share is the **experience of trinitization**. Some came into being through it; others received the Trinity embrace at the end of their ascent. The author himself is a Mighty Messenger, a being who began as a mortal and received this embrace, and so this paper touches our own future in a special way.
p022.s1.h: I. The Trinity-Embraced Sons — Seven Orders, Three Divisions
p022.s1.b0: After the embrace, the Trinity-embraced sons are forever devoted to Trinity service, and for superuniverse service they are organized into seven orders of personalities. By origin, nature, and function these seven are grouped again into three divisions: Sons of Attainment, Sons of Selection, and Sons of Perfection.

p022.s1.b2: When the Sons of Attainment are embraced, their names are removed from the finaliter roll call. And while their Trinity-origin associates, the Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors, are of fixed numbers, the Trinity-embraced sons keep increasing. Each superuniverse receives exactly the same number, and not one has ever been lost.

p022.s1.b3.q: Trinity-embraced beings have never gone astray

p022.s1.b4: The author adds frankly, however, that the Sons of Perfection have sometimes erred in judgment and caused transient confusion. This small qualification leads later into the paper’s great theme: the value of experience.
p022.s2.h: II. The Mighty Messengers — Loyalty That Was Tested
p022.s2.b0: The Mighty Messengers are perfected mortals who have been rebellion tested or otherwise proved in their personal loyalty. At some point in their ascent they stood firm in the face of the disloyalty of their superiors. Yet this paper values action that prevents rebellion even more highly than loyalty in the face of it.

p022.s2.b1.q: action designed to prevent rebellion or to effect higher types of loyalty in a universe crisis is regarded as of even greater value than loyalty in the face of actual rebellion.

p022.s2.b2: The author tells us that the companion of his own mortal experience also triumphed in the great test; after long separations during the ascent, they were embraced in the same group of seven hundred thousand and are now often sent out together. The Messengers act as defenders of individuals and planets in the superuniverse courts and are stationed on many worlds as official observers of the Ancients of Days. Because they remain fully conscious of their whole ascendant careers, they are sympathetic ministers to any creature.

p022.s2.b3.q: As soon as you are delivered from the flesh, you will communicate freely and understandingly with us

p022.s3.h: III–IV. Those High in Authority and Those without Name and Number — Administrative Genius and Souls of Worship
p022.s3.b0: Those High in Authority are mortals who showed superior administrative ability and executive genius throughout their ascent, and they present the cause of justice in the superuniverse tribunals. Because our prosecutors would be onetime ascenders who know every step of our path, the paper says we are hardly likely to suffer injustice. Those without Name and Number are souls whose ability to worship has developed beyond that of all others, giving them a spiritual concept above name and number; they serve as the supreme jurors of Orvonton.

p022.s3.b1.q: Adjudication is the highest function of any government, and those who are intrusted with verdict rendering should be chosen from the highest and most noble types of the most experienced and understanding individuals.

p022.s3.b2: The selection of candidates for these three orders is not arbitrary but inherent and automatic: personal experience and spiritual values determine who they are. So although they are equal in authority and status, they differ as much as their ascendant careers differed. When the viewpoint of a mortal creature is in doubt, an ascendant commission of a Mighty Messenger, One High in Authority, and One without Name and Number settles the question.
p022.s4.h: V–VI. The Trinitized Custodians and Ambassadors — A Share for Those Who Walked Beside Us
p022.s4.b0: The story of the Sons of Selection shows that ascension is not the work of mortals alone. Our seraphic guardians and midway associates, too, may traverse Havona, attain Paradise, and receive the same Trinity recognition. Seraphim are so honored because of their valiant co-operation with an ascendant mortal who was later trinitized; the author’s own seraphic guardian now serves on Uversa as a Trinitized Custodian.
p022.s4.b1: The Custodians are officers of the superuniverse who handle not individuals but group affairs: records, plans, and institutions. The Ambassadors are chosen from Spirit-fused and Son-fused mortals on the advice of their Havona teachers; as emissaries of the Ancients of Days and their emergency reserve corps, they carry out countless duties that human minds cannot picture.

p022.s5.h: VII. Technique of Trinitization — The Adventure of Two Becoming One
p022.s5.b0: The techniques of trinitization belong to the secrets of Vicegerington and Solitarington and can be understood only by those who have experienced them. Apart from the Deities, only Paradise-Havona personalities and certain finaliters engage in it; mortal finaliters may attempt it as one of seven ways to spend the recess granted every millennium of Havona time. A creature may take part in such an experience only once.
p022.s5.b1: If two finaliters show that they have independently chosen the same concept, the Architects may extend their recess, and Master Spirit Number Seven authorizes the undertaking. Unbelievably long ages may follow, and the effort may fail through no discoverable error. Those who fail are admitted to a special group of finaliters.

p022.s5.b2.q: Candidates for trinitization who thus fail are admitted to a special group of finaliters who are designated as beings who have made the supreme effort and sustained the supreme disappointment.

p022.s5.b3: If they succeed, the two parents become one functionally and spiritually. They are still listed as two personalities, but during the present universe age they are inseparable in assignment and function. The experience is on the order of the Father and the Son becoming one in eternalizing the Infinite Spirit, yet this union is not eternal; it will end with the completed factualization of the experiential Deities.

p022.s5.b4.q: where one goes the other goes, what one does the other does.

p022.s6.h: VIII. The Creature-Trinitized Sons — Many Paths of Destiny
p022.s6.b0: All creature-trinitized beings, revealed or not, receive personality from the Universal Father. Young ascender-trinitized and Paradise-Havona-trinitized sons first serve under the Supreme Executives on the seven Paradise spheres of the Infinite Spirit, and may then be adopted by Trinity Teacher Sons for training as apprentices in the local universes. When the Teacher Sons nominate them for the Trinity embrace, they emerge as Trinitized Sons of Perfection.
p022.s6.b1: Many are never embraced. They become associates of the Master Spirits, the Reflective Spirits, and the Mother Spirits, take special assignments on Paradise and the secret worlds, or join the conjoint corps on the inner Havona circuit. The paper says that the supreme destiny of most creature-trinitized sons appears to be entrance into the Corps of Trinitized Finaliters.
p022.s7.h: IX–X. The Celestial Guardians and High Son Assistants — Perfection Without Experience
p022.s7.b0: Creature-trinitized sons are embraced in classes of seven thousand; on the advice of the Teacher Sons, those of more acceptable service become High Son Assistants and those of less distinguished performance become Celestial Guardians. The Guardians are officers of the courts of the Ancients of Days, bearing summonses and bringing in those whose presence is required. They have never been indwelt by Adjusters nor fused with Spirit or Son; the Trinity embrace compensates for this nonfused status.
p022.s7.b1: The author says that these twice-trinitized sons are neither as versatile nor as dependable as their ascendant associates, because they lack the experience of actually climbing up to glory from the dark domains of space. On the mansion worlds he has seen them look longingly at even new arrivals, and their willingness to acknowledge their deficiencies is transcendently beautiful.

p022.s7.b2.q: There is simply nothing in all universal existence which can take the place of actual personal experience

p022.s7.b4: In fairness, the author also names the great strength of the High Son Assistants. Each personifies a divine idea never before trinitized. On a commission he headed, one problem was embodied in an Assistant on Uversa and another in an Assistant of superuniverse number three, and nothing compared with the help of such a living presence. The only difficulty is that each superuniverse receives just one seventh of these beings.

p022.s7.b6.q: They are touchingly affectionate, superbly loyal, exquisitely intelligent, supremely wise—regarding a single idea—and transcendently humble.

p022.s8.b0: Paper 22 may look like a staff roster of superuniverse government, but beneath it runs one conviction: nothing can replace experience. Even beings who embody perfect ideas envy those who climb up from humble origins. And the author tells his mortal readers that they, too, may one day receive the Trinity embrace and be sent to enlarge the revelation of truth to some evolving planet.

p022.s8.b2: Papers 23 and 24 turn to the family of the Infinite Spirit, introducing the Solitary Messengers and the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit. If we remember the map of the seven orders in this paper, it becomes much clearer how much the government of the Ancients of Days rests on the experience of ascenders.
p023.lead: The first personalities the Infinite Spirit made alone, Solitary Messengers who are true persons without form: beings who work by themselves yet bind everyone together.

p023.foot.text: Presented by a Divine Counselor from Uversa

p023.s0.h: Introduction — The Infinite Spirit’s First Solitary Creation
p023.s0.b0: If Paper 22 dealt with the Trinitized Sons, Paper 23 introduces the **Solitary Messengers**, the first and senior order of the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit. They represent the first creative act of the Infinite Spirit functioning alone, without the direct participation of the Father or the Son. Because they were personalized in a single creative episode, their number is fixed.

p023.s0.b1.q: Solitary Messengers are the personal and universal corps of the Conjoint Creator

p023.s0.b2: The author, a Divine Counselor, tells us that a Solitary Messenger accompanies him on this very mission. Yet even he does not know their total number. Almost 7,690 trillion were reported operating within Orvonton, and he conjectures that this is considerably less than one seventh of the whole.
p023.s1.h: I. Nature and Origin of Solitary Messengers — Alone, but Not Lonely
p023.s1.b0: The Infinite Spirit brought the Solitary Messengers into being immediately after creating the Seven Spirits of the Havona Circuits. Except for Paradise and the Havona circuits, no part of creation is older than they are. Even so, all of them are aware of a beginning of selfhood; they are the first of the Infinite Spirit’s creatures to possess time consciousness. They came forth fully grown, and since all are equal, they are classified only by the work they are currently assigned.

p023.s1.b2: Despite their name, they are not lonely spirits. They truly like to work alone and are the only beings in all creation who can enjoy a solitary existence. They can also “listen in” on all the broadcasts of the realms where they serve, so they stay in touch with the wealth of the intellect of all creation. There is no record of a Solitary Messenger falling into darkness, and the council of the Master Spirits has never once had to adjudicate one of their cases.

p023.s1.b3.q: Though denominated Solitary Messengers, they are not lonesome spirits, for they truly like to work alone.

p023.s1.b4.q: There is no record that a Solitary Messenger ever stumbled into darkness.

p023.s1.b5: There is also a technical reason they must travel alone. When in transit or working in the circuits of time and space, if two or more are close together they are thrown out of liaison with the higher circulating forces; they are “short circuited.” So they have an automatic alarm that warns of approaching conflicts, and they can also detect the nearness of Inspired Trinity Spirits and Thought Adjusters.
p023.s1.b6: They have no power to extend or reproduce personality, yet there is almost no work of the universes to which they cannot contribute. They live on Paradise and act by the authority of the Infinite Spirit as personalized in the local universes, and even under the influence of a local Mother Spirit they remain constant partakers of the direct circuit from the Infinite Spirit. The author says they are great timesavers for everyone, from the highest to the lowest.
p023.s2.h: II. Assignments of Solitary Messengers — Seven Divisions of Service
p023.s2.b0: Solitary Messengers are not permanently attached to any individual or group, and among themselves they have no organization or government. The Infinite Spirit assigns them to seven divisions of service, but they move freely and constantly from one to another. They are usually designated by number, but the Infinite Spirit knows each by a personal name.

p023.s2.b2: While describing the first division, the author turns suddenly to the confusion of Urantia. The Creators could make this world a veritable paradise, he says, but such an Eden would not develop strong, noble, and experienced characters. Our anxieties, sorrows, and disappointments are as much a part of the divine plan here as perfection is in the central universe.

p023.s2.b3.q: such an Eden would not contribute to the development of those strong, noble, and experienced characters which the Gods are so surely forging out on your world between the anvils of necessity and the hammers of anguish.

p023.s2.b4: Among the superuniverse messengers, the author’s own companion was sent from Uversa to the central universe long before there was life on Urantia; he was absent from the Orvonton roll calls for almost a million years and returned with the desired information. Of all the supercreations, the Solitary Messengers most delight to serve in Orvonton, because here the need is greatest and the opportunities for heroic effort are multiplied.

p023.s2.b5.q: In the more needy realms we all enjoy the satisfaction of a more replete function.

p023.s2.b6: The explorers of the fifth division volunteer when the reserve corps is overrecruited, and there is never a lack of volunteers. Being highly sensitive to gravity, they can detect even very small dark planets suited to life experiments, and working with the celestial astronomers they bring back much of what is known about outer space. The seventh division, revealing truth, is the work this order regards as its highest trust, and they are often attached to commissions sent to enlarge revelation to worlds and systems.

p023.s2.b7.q: The Solitary Messengers regard the assignment to reveal truth as the highest trust of their order.

p023.s3.h: III. Time and Space Services — The Fastest Messengers Who Are Persons
p023.s3.b0: The universe has gravity traversers that move instantly, and it has personalities, such as angels and men, bound by time and space. Between the instantaneous velocity of the gravity traversers and the comparatively slow speed of the seraphim, the Solitary Messengers are the only personal messengers who function. So they are used where personality is essential and the loss of time must be avoided.

p023.s3.b2: What the author finds hardest to explain is that Solitary Messengers are without form and yet are true individuals. In the seven superuniverses, liberation from time and space ordinarily diminishes personality prerogatives, but the Solitary Messengers are an exception to this general law. They have the advantages of a formless spirit together with all the prerogatives of a full personality.

p023.s3.b3.q: They are true persons, yet endowed with nearly all of the attributes of impersonal spirit manifestation.

p023.s3.b4: The author admits he cannot explain to a material mind how a spirit can be a real person and still travel through space at such speeds. But because it is so, universe administration does not lose its personal character. Speed and personality together: that is the unique place the Solitary Messengers fill.

p023.s3.b5.q: the whole economy of universal administration would be largely deprived of its personal element were this not a fact.

p023.s3.b6: However much the universe grows, no more Solitary Messengers will probably ever be created. The expanding work of administration will increasingly fall to other spirit ministers and to beings originating in the new creations.
p023.s3.b7: In remote regions of space beyond the established circuits, they serve as emergency lines of communication, able to send a message to a fellow messenger about one hundred light-years away. The author declares that of all the beings who co-operate in superuniverse affairs, none are more important in practical help and timesaving, for through personal communication they are somewhat independent of space, and through their tremendous speed nearly independent of time.
p023.s4.h: IV. Special Ministry of Solitary Messengers — Those Who Join Personalities Together
p023.s4.b0: The Solitary Messengers seem to be **personality co-ordinators** for all types of spirit beings. They help spirits of different types and orders understand and fraternize with one another, and they foster in all spirit beings a consciousness of group identity. That those who work alone should be the ones who make everyone kin is the lovely paradox of this paper.

p023.s4.b1.q: Their ministry helps to make all the personalities of the far-flung spiritual world akin.

p023.s4.b2: When a finaliter and a Paradise Citizen trinitize a “⟦Q 23:4.3⟧child of time and eternity⟦/Q⟧” and that son is sent to Vicegerington, a Solitary Messenger is always assigned as his guardian-companion and never again leaves. Since the messengers are of fixed number and the trinitization of sons of destiny seems unlimited, it appears that the supply will one day run out. Here the author frankly lists questions he cannot answer.

p023.s4.b5.q: And we anticipate such tremendous adventures, even as you should, with keen relish and ever-heightening expectation.

p023.s5.b0: Paper 23 reads like a description of a cosmic communications network, yet it holds a deep insight into solitude and fellowship. The Solitary Messengers enjoy working alone, yet they bind all personalities together as kin. The author also tells us that a world of suffering is a forge for character, and that greater need brings greater satisfaction. Even high beings admit what they do not know and meet the future with expectation.

p023.s5.b2: Paper 24 introduces other Higher Personalities from the same family of the Infinite Spirit: beings who supervise the spirit circuits, keep count of will creatures, and guide pilgrims through Havona. Remembering that the Solitary Messengers are the eldest of that family makes the place of the orders that follow easier to see.

p024.s0.b2: Most of these higher personalities have stations in the local universes, yet they are not organically attached to the administrations of the evolutionary realms. They are, so to speak, an unseen infrastructure that works alongside local governments without being part of them.

p024.s1.b0: The power currents of space and the circuits of spirit energy may seem to run automatically, but in fact they are under intelligent supervision. The Universe Circuit Supervisors deal not with purely physical energy but with the circuits of relative spiritual energy needed to sustain spiritual and morontia beings. They do not originate these circuits; they direct and manipulate all such spirit-energy circuits outside the Isle of Paradise.

p024.s1.b1.q: All these stupendous systems of energy are under control; they are subject to intelligent supervision.

p024.s1.b3: Circuit supervisors serve forever in their original assignment and are never rotated, so they make an agelong study of the problems of their realms. Tertiary circuit supervisor number 572,842 has served on Salvington since the early concept of Nebadon and is a member of Michael’s personal staff. It is they who would isolate a world from the higher spiritual circuits if its Planetary Prince rebelled, though they cannot annul the material currents of the power directors.
p024.s1.b4: The circuit supervisors and the Universe Power Directors complement each other, the one overseeing spirit circuits and the other material circuits. Yet they are not co-ordinate; the circuit supervisors are subject to the Supreme Power Directors, and the circuits of pure mind are under the supervision of neither. They possess a unique type of personality, other than that bestowed by the Father, and though ascenders will come to know them, they will have no personal relations with them.
p024.s2.h: II. The Census Directors — Those Who Know Where Will Exists
p024.s2.b0: Although the cosmic mind knows of all thinking creatures, there is an independent method of keeping count of will creatures. The Census Directors become aware of the birth of will anywhere in the grand universe the moment it happens and can report the number, nature, and whereabouts of all will creatures. They do not, however, function on Paradise, for there it is not needed.

p024.s2.b1.q: On Paradise knowledge is inherent; the Deities know all things.

p024.s2.b2: Orvonton has one hundred thousand Census Directors assignable to its local universes, and Usatia, the superuniverse chief, does not register will directly but totals the reports coming in from each local creation. They record only the fact of will function; they are not recorders of anyone’s life and deeds. The partial emergence of will in higher animals lies outside their domain.

p024.s2.b3.q: The Census Director of Nebadon, number 81,412 of Orvonton, now stationed on Salvington, is at this very moment personally conscious and aware of your living presence here on Urantia

p024.s2.b4: That we were registered the moment we first exercised will, and that our death will be noted when we perform our last act of will, reminds us how weighty a thing will is in the universe. These directors are flawless in their work; they never default and never falsify.

p024.s2.b5.q: But they are infallible in function

p024.s3.h: III. Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit — Nearly the Only Ones We Will Not Meet
p024.s3.b0: When and how the Personal Aids were created is not known, and their number is estimated to run high into the trillions. They serve only the Paradise presence of the Third Person of Deity, flashing to and fro to the uttermost parts of creation. All are equal and identical, and they do not manifest a spirit presence to other spirit beings. This very lack of a presence-form makes them all the more serviceable to the Infinite Spirit.

p024.s3.b1.q: Of all the revealed orders of spirit beings taking origin in the Infinite Spirit, the Personal Aids are about the only ones you will not encounter on your inward ascent to Paradise.

p024.s4.h: IV–V. The Associate Inspectors and the Assigned Sentinels — Eyes and Ears of the Supreme Executives
p024.s4.b0: The Seven Supreme Executives on the Paradise spheres of the Infinite Spirit are the board of supermanagers for the seven superuniverses. The Associate Inspectors, joint offspring of the Infinite Spirit and the Seven Master Spirits, were personalized seven hundred thousand strong in the near times of eternity, and they represent the authority of the Supreme Executives in each local universe. The Assigned Sentinels, exactly seven billion in number, do the same in each system of a local universe.

An Assigned Sentinel ranks among the highest personalities on a system capital, yet never takes part in deliberations on system affairs; he serves as ex officio head of the four and twenty administrators from the evolutionary worlds. Thus the paper shows a centralized yet far-flung system of advisory and administrative co-ordination for the whole grand universe.
p024.s5.h: VI. The Graduate Guides — Companions on the Havona Road
p024.s5.b0: The Graduate Guides conduct the high university that is essential to mortal attainment of the goal of the ages: God, rest, and then eternity of perfected service. The author all but despairs of portraying their work to a material mind, but he comforts us that our vision will not always be so limited.

p024.s5.b1.q: You are not always to be so limited in the range of your vision and spiritual comprehension.

p024.s5.b3: Until the first mortal pilgrim reached the outer circuit of Havona, there was no record of any Graduate Guide in the central universe. The one who greeted that pilgrim, Grandfanda, was Malvorian, the first of the guides. His arrival sent the thrill of all time through the heavenly courts and signaled the start of the universe-wide broadcast, the “⟦Q 24:6.8⟧space reports of glory⟦/Q⟧.”

p024.s5.b4.q: did conduct him from the outer circuits of initial experience, step by step and circuit by circuit, until he stood in the very presence of the Source and Destiny of all personality

p024.s5.b5: The author recalls that he himself was serving on Uversa at that distant time, and that all rejoiced in the assurance that pilgrims from their own superuniverse would one day reach Havona. Grandfanda came from a planet in superuniverse number one. The first proof that an evolutionary creature could actually reach the goal became the joy of the whole universe.

p024.s5.b6.q: And you will sometime meet these noble beings face to face if you do not reject the certain and all-perfected plan designed to effect your survival and ascension.

p024.s6.h: VII. Origin of the Graduate Guides — Beings Who Grew Through Service
p024.s6.b0: Evolution is not the order of the central universe, yet the revelators believe that the Graduate Guides are transformed Havona Servitals, the more experienced of them. When a servital returns from superuniverse service, is granted “personal contact” with the Paradise Central Shining, and disappears, a newborn Graduate Guide appears on the outer Havona circuit just three moments later, and the number of guides exactly equals the number of vanished servitals.

p024.s6.b1.q: knew the Father, entered the divine embrace, and is not.

p024.s6.b2: The paper reasons that the guides understand ascenders so deeply because they gained that culture by actual service in the superuniverse realms. The inexplicable attachment between guides and servitals is further evidence. And since Grandfanda, Havona itself has changed greatly, in modifications initiated by the Supreme Being, the God of evolutionary creatures, in response to the arrival of his first experiential children.
p024.s6.b3: The paper also cautiously suggests the background of this change. The Havona Servitals are created by the Master Spirits and the Supreme Power Directors, who hold the not-yet-operating mind and power potentials of the Supreme, so they are inherently involved in phases of Supremacy. When a servital is re-created as a guide, the evolutionary potentials of time and space are reflected in the central universe, and the revelators conjecture that experiential Deity is in some way concerned.
p024.s7.b0: Paper 24 is a tour of the grand universe’s infrastructure. The spirit circuits are intelligently managed, every will is counted, and the state of every region is faithfully reported to the Supreme Executives. And at the far end of the long journey waits a guide who himself grew through service. The universe is not an indifferent machine; it is woven as a web of care.

p024.s7.b2: Paper 25 moves to the second grand division, the Messenger Hosts of Space. If the higher personalities of this paper form the skeleton of the grand universe, the messenger hosts that follow are the beings who move between its parts, assisting the courts, the records, and the journey of the ascenders.
p025.lead: The messenger hosts who link the higher personalities with the ministering spirits: beings who settle disputes, interpret law, keep the records, and simply stay by our side.

p025.foot.text: Sponsored by One High in Authority from Uversa

p025.s0.h: Introduction — The Middle Ranks of the Spirit’s Family
p025.s0.b0: Paper 24 dealt with the higher personalities of the Infinite Spirit; Paper 25 introduces the intermediate ranks of that same family, the **Messenger Hosts of Space**. These versatile beings serve as the connecting links between the higher personalities and the ministering spirits. Of the seven groups, three are created as such, while the other four represent levels of attainment reached by the angelic orders.

p025.s0.b2: These beings do many kinds of work according to their nature and status, but they always serve under the direction of those who rule the realms of their assignment. One question runs through the whole paper: in a universe that is not yet perfect, how are very different beings helped to live together?
p025.s1.h: I. The Havona Servitals — A World Without Menial Work
p025.s1.b0: Though called servitals, these “midway creatures” of the central universe are not servants in any lowly sense. They are the joint creation of the Master Spirits and the Supreme Power Directors, and this collaboration is the nearest pattern for the long line of dual-order reproduction that reaches from a Creator Son–Creative Spirit liaison all the way down to sex procreation on worlds like Urantia. They appear a thousand at a time, in a ratio of three spirit beings to one semiphysical.

p025.s1.b1.q: In the spiritual world there is no such thing as menial work; all service is sacred and exhilarating

p025.s1.b2: The servitals and the Graduate Guides are bound by deep affection, and there is divine pathos when they part. Yet the servitals go with joy, not sorrow, for the satisfying joy of high duty outshines every other feeling. Here the author adds that when an ascending soul stands before the Supreme Judge, the verdict will rest not on material success or quantitative achievement but on faithfulness in the essentials.

p025.s1.b3.q: Sorrow cannot exist in the face of the consciousness of divine duty faithfully performed.

p025.s1.b4: In Orvonton almost 138 billion servitals minister on the 490 educational satellites that surround the superuniverse capital. They have come down from our next career to study us and to assure us that our graduation from time to eternity is real and certain. This experience serves them well later in Havona, where they work as associates of the Graduate Guides or, once translated, as Graduate Guides themselves.
p025.s2.h: II–III. The Universal Conciliators — From Judges to Teachers
p025.s2.b0: Each time a Havona Servital is created, seven conciliators appear, one in each superuniverse, because the Reflective Spirits at the superuniverse headquarters respond reflectively to the creative event on Paradise. Each superuniverse mirrors the character of the Master Spirit who presides over its destiny, so the conciliators as a whole display forty-nine partial but complementary viewpoints.

p025.s2.b2: Because the advocate is detached while a case is being judged, a commission in session functions as three, and so these groups are sometimes called **referee trios**. Traveling at the seraphic rate of triple velocity, they are the traveling courts of the worlds, devoted to the quick settlement of minor difficulties. They never pass on matters of eternal import, so the soul’s eternal prospects are never placed in jeopardy by their acts; yet once they accept a case, their rulings are final and always unanimous.
p025.s2.b3: Why are such commissions needed? The moment the Creators bring into being creatures with the power of choice, misunderstanding becomes unavoidable. The Creators could have made the local universes as perfect as Havona. They chose instead to make universes rich in differences and difficulties, and with them the means of harmonizing those differences.

p025.s2.b4.q: misunderstandings are certain to arise, and provision for the fair adjustment of these honest differences of viewpoint must be made.

p025.s2.b6: This path of promotion is itself a lesson. Those who once arbitrated conflicts born of ignorance end up teaching the wisdom and tolerance that avoid such clashes in the first place. The four members remain together forever just as they were first associated, embodying the supreme justice of time and space.

p025.s2.b7.q: The higher a creature’s education, the more respect he has for the knowledge, experience, and opinions of others.

p025.s2.b8.q: They are eternally associated as the embodiment of the supreme justice of time and space.

p025.s3.h: IV. Technical Advisers — A Living Library of Applied Law
p025.s3.b0: Technical Advisers are not created as such. The Infinite Spirit chose as their nucleus one million of the most orderly minds among the early supernaphim and omniaphim, and since then actual experience has been required. Their ranks are drawn from supernaphim, seconaphim, tertiaphim, omniaphim, and seraphim, and some ascending mortals and midwayers serve with them for a time. They are organized in groups of seven, at least five of whom must be of permanent status.
p025.s3.b1: In speaking of the mortals who serve with them transiently, the paper states a principle of the entire ascending career. All the way in to Havona we are pupil-teachers, rising by passing on our newly gained knowledge to those just below us.

p025.s3.b2.q: In the universal regime you are not reckoned as having possessed yourself of knowledge and truth until you have demonstrated your ability and your willingness to impart this knowledge and truth to others.

p025.s3.b3: Their training begins in the Melchizedek colleges, continues in the courts of the Ancients of Days and the “⟦Q 25:4.14⟧schools of the seven circles⟦/Q⟧” in Havona, and is completed in the Paradise “⟦Q 25:4.14⟧college of the ethics of law and the technique of Supremacy⟦/Q⟧.” A living library of applied law cannot be created; it must be evolved by experience. These advisers prevent delay, facilitate progress, and guide us toward the better way that exists in everything.

p025.s3.b4.q: There is always a best and right way to do things; there is always the technique of perfection, a divine method

p025.s4.h: V–VI. The Custodians of Records and the Celestial Recorders — A Universe That Does Not Forget
p025.s4.b0: Everything of importance is recorded, and records move upward from local to higher levels according to the scope of their significance. The recording angels of the inhabited planets are the source of all individual records, and on Paradise the digests of superuniverse and Havona data are kept by the Custodians of Records, who are senior tertiary supernaphim. The Celestial Recorders are ascendant seraphim who can handle spiritual and material energy at once, producing an original spirit record together with a semimaterial copy.

p025.s4.b2: Thanks to this dual recording, every class of being, from the material order to the high spirits of light, can consult the records. As we ascend we will always be able to learn the history and traditions of our status sphere. No Celestial Recorder has ever been known to defect or falsify a record, and their work is doubly inspected, including by the Mighty Messengers.
p025.s5.h: VII–VIII. The Morontia Companions and the Paradise Companions — The Ministry of Presence
p025.s5.b0: The Morontia Companions are children of the local universe Mother Spirits. They are gracious hosts to those just beginning the long ascent, and skillful sponsors of play. The paper promises that there will always be time for rest and spirit play along the way. Because they serve only in the local universes, we will truly regret parting from them when we leave the morontia life behind.

p025.s5.b1.q: Throughout the journey to Paradise there will always be time for rest and spirit play

p025.s5.b2: The Paradise Companions are recruited from several angelic orders and serve for a season; aside from permanent status on Paradise, this is the highest honor ever conferred on ministering spirits. They have nothing in particular to accomplish. When nearly every other being we meet has something definite to do with us or for us, these companions are assigned simply to be with us as personality associates.

p025.s5.b4.q: The Creators well know that it is “not good for man to be alone,” and provision is accordingly made for companionship, even on Paradise.

p025.s5.b6: This care, which makes sure that someone always accompanies a defeated pilgrim, shows that failure in Havona is not an end but a temporary detour. The companion remains with him until he returns to the central universe to resume the Paradise ascent.
p025.s6.b0: Paper 25 can look like a list of administrative departments, but it holds wisdom for life in an imperfect world. Misunderstandings will come, and so fair conciliation is needed. What we learn becomes truly ours only when we share it. And the universe refuses to leave anyone alone.

p025.s6.b2: Paper 26 returns to the central universe and introduces the Ministering Spirits of the Central Universe, the supernaphim who teach and guide ascenders on the circuits of Havona. Keeping in mind the places of the Havona Servitals and the Paradise Companions met here will make that Havona pilgrimage all the more vivid.
p026.lead: The supernaphim who welcome, teach, and finally put to rest the pilgrims on the seven circuits of Havona: the last school, from perfection of purpose to the true rest.

p026.foot.text: Presented by a Perfector of Wisdom from Uversa

p026.s0.h: Introduction — The Highest Order of the Angelic Hosts
p026.s0.b0: Paper 26 turns to the lowest group among the children of the Infinite Spirit, the **ministering spirits**, that is, the angelic hosts. The highest of these are the ministering spirits of Paradise and the central universe, the **supernaphim**. The paper traces, circuit by circuit, how the supernaphim guide the pilgrims of time through the seven circles of Havona.
p026.s0.b1: So this paper is both a study of angels and a guidebook to the last school of the ascending mortal. Havona is a place we must one day actually pass through, and the paper shows in advance what we will learn there, what tests we will face, and who will be beside us.
p026.s1.h: I. The Ministering Spirits — An Unbroken Chain of Ministry
p026.s1.b0: Angels are the ministering associates of evolving and ascending will creatures, and every order consists of distinct, highly individualized personalities. They are very social and enjoy seasons of rest and change. Angelic status is not wholly fixed: angels may become Paradise Companions, Celestial Recorders, or Technical Advisers, and evolutionary seraphim may even attain the spiritual levels of the ascending sons.

p026.s1.b2: Of these, the supernaphim, seconaphim, and seraphim are the ones employed on a large scale in the ascension plan. Working respectively in the central universe, the superuniverses, and the local universes, they form a single chain of ministry to all who seek the Father through the Eternal Son. Angels are sustained directly by the spiritual energy of the primary circuits of the universe, and they take in knowledge in much the same way.

p026.s1.b3.q: they “have food that you know not.”

p026.s2.h: II. The Mighty Supernaphim — Three Orders and Their Origins
p026.s2.b0: The primary supernaphim are offspring of the Conjoint Creator. They divide their ministry almost equally between the Paradise Citizens and the ascending pilgrims, helping each group understand the other: the one the highest of perfect will creatures, the other beings who have evolved to perfection from the lowest types. Their work is described in the next paper.
p026.s2.b1: The secondary supernaphim are created individually by each of the Seven Master Spirits and so fall into seven types. The tertiary supernaphim are made by the seven Circuit Spirits under the authority of the Infinite Spirit. The Circuit Spirits made comparatively few tertiary supernaphim before the pilgrims came, but the Master Spirits did not even begin creating secondary supernaphim until Grandfanda arrived. Here we glimpse a creative capacity that responds to the growth of the experiential Deities and the evolving universes.
p026.s3.h: III. The Tertiary Supernaphim — Keeping Havona Running Smoothly
p026.s3.b0: In Havona the pilgrims of time pass inward from the outer seventh circuit, while the descending pilgrims of Paradise pass outward from the first. There is no time limit on any circuit, and although some ascenders are excused from parts of the local universe training worlds, no one escapes passing through all seven circuits of Havona.

p026.s4.h: IV. The Secondary Supernaphim — Arriving with Perfection of Purpose
p026.s4.b0: The secondary supernaphim serve the pilgrims in seven working groups on the seven circuits of Havona. A pilgrim is always tutored by supernaphim who originate in the Master Spirit presiding over his own superuniverse of nativity. We of Orvonton, then, will be understood and comforted by teachers who come from the same Master Spirit as we do.

p026.s4.b2: The pilgrim arrives on the receiving world of Havona with only one kind of perfection: **perfection of purpose**. That purpose has been thoroughly proved, the faith has been tested, and the pilgrim is known to be disappointment proof. Now, inside the door that faith has opened, perfection of understanding must be developed.

p026.s4.b3.q: Ability to comprehend is the mortal passport to Paradise. Willingness to believe is the key to Havona.

p026.s5.h: V–VI. The Pilgrim Helpers and the Supremacy Guides — First Lessons and the Experience of the Supreme
p026.s5.b0: The pilgrim helpers welcome the much-traveled ascenders to the settled worlds of Havona and teach them the elementary course on the Trinity, the Father-Son partnership, and the Infinite Spirit. The paper adds that long before reaching Havona these pilgrims have learned to turn uncertainty, disappointment, and difficulty into nourishment for growth.

p026.s5.b1.q: “In liaison with God, nothing—absolutely nothing—is impossible.”

p026.s5.b2: In Havona time matters little; achievement is the final test. On the sixth circle the ascenders, now “spiritual graduates,” come under the supremacy guides and reach a new realization of God the Supreme. No personalized presence of Supremacy can be perceived, yet they undergo a new integration of consciousness and a new sensitivity for divinity. The author says it looks as if God the Supreme were affectionately bestowing enhancements upon his experiential children.
p026.s6.h: VII–VIII. The Trinity Guides and the Son Finders — The Deity Adventure and the Meaning of Failure
p026.s6.b0: On the fifth circle the pilgrim becomes a “candidate for the Deity adventure” and discovers, for the first time, what real study and mental effort are. Each pilgrim receives the undivided attention and affection of a Trinity guide. When he finally sets out for Paradise, he goes with the transit trio: his superaphic circle associate, the Graduate Guide, and the Guide’s servital associate. The quest for the Infinite Spirit seldom fails.
p026.s6.b1: The fourth circuit is the “circle of the Sons,” where the pilgrims of time and the pilgrims of eternity first truly understand one another. After the Infinite Spirit is attained there are no more examinations; progress is decided purely by individual spirituality. And if a pilgrim fails, no one is ever chided.

p026.s6.b2.q: On Paradise, disappointment is never regarded as defeat; postponement is never looked upon as disgrace; the apparent failures of time are never confused with the significant delays of eternity.

p026.s6.b3: Defeated candidates serve for no less than a millennium in whichever superuniverse best suits their retraining, then return of their own accord and resume on the circle where their career was interrupted. The secondary supernaphim never fail to pilot their subjects successfully on the second attempt, and the same ministers attend them throughout.
p026.s7.h: IX–X. The Father Guides and the Counselors — The Command to Be Perfect Is Obeyed
p026.s7.b0: On the third circle the most experienced Father guides prepare the pilgrims for the final adventure. Attaining the Father is the passport to eternity. At this moment, the author declares, the whole ascension plan has proved feasible, and the justice of the command “⟦Q 26:9.3⟧Be you perfect, even as I am perfect⟦/Q⟧” has been forever demonstrated.

p026.s7.b1.q: Step by step, life by life, world by world, the ascendant career has been mastered, and the goal of Deity has been attained.

p026.s7.b2: On the second circle the counselors and advisers teach the responsibilities of eternity while also comforting the disappointed pilgrims who have been advanced there directly from the circle of their failure. Their failure lay not in a defect of spirit but in some part of their technique of approach or their experiential background. Certified by the councils of perfection, they return joyfully to service in time and become the most loving ministers to those who suffer temporal disappointments.

p026.s7.b3.q: These are they who have drained the experiential cup to its dregs

p026.s7.b4: For the successful pilgrims, some of the anticipative enthusiasm fades. Many look back on their long struggle with a joyous envy and wish they could begin it all again, the paper says, just as mortals in old age sometimes long to relive the struggles of their youth.
p026.s8.h: XI. The Complements of Rest — No One Sleeps Alone
p026.s8.b0: On the first circle the ascenders learn to adjust to the many groups of beings they will meet on Paradise. Here also are gathered the conjoint corps of the creature-trinitized sons, preparing for future work. The complements of rest care less about training than about promoting understanding fellowship among these various groups.
p026.s8.b1: At this point the author corrects a common misunderstanding. It is a mistake to call divine mercy and tenderness toward the weak a sign of a manlike God. Rather, the mercy and forbearance shown by human beings are evidence that the spirit of the living God dwells within them.

p026.s8.b2.q: The mortal creature must find God. The Creator Son never stops until he finds man—the lowest will creature.

p026.s8.b3: When we fall asleep on the pilot world of the last circuit, we will not be alone. The complement of rest who has been our associate since we reached the first circle comes to our side and enters the rest as one with us. Only those who go to sleep on the first circle of Havona and awaken on the shores of Paradise become children of eternity.

p026.s9.b0: Paper 26 pictures Havona not as an examination hall but as a school woven of love. The pilgrim arrives carrying only perfection of purpose, yet on every circuit a teacher who understands him is waiting; failure brings no reproach; and even the last sleep is shared. The disappointments and uncertainties we face now are part of building the faith that will admit us to that school.

p027.lead: The primary supernaphim who receive and train ascenders on Paradise in seven stages: the final training, which begins with rest and ends with worship.

p027.foot.text: Presented by a Perfector of Wisdom from Uversa

p027.s0.h: Introduction — The Last Instructors on Paradise
p027.s0.b0: Paper 26 described the secondary supernaphim who help pilgrims on the circuits of Havona; Paper 27 introduces the **primary supernaphim**, who serve the Deities on the Isle of Paradise, the destination of the whole journey. These children of the Infinite Spirit are supreme in perfection, and from eternity not one of them has ever strayed from the paths of light and righteousness. The author records the fact in a short, firm sentence.
p027.s0.b2: They do not function widely outside Paradise, but there is an exception. On worlds isolated by rebellion and then reclaimed through the bestowal of a Paradise Son, a primary supernaphim takes command of the seraphic hosts there. The present “⟦Q 27:0.2⟧chief of seraphim⟦/Q⟧” on Urantia is the second of this order on duty since the bestowal of Christ Michael. It is striking that the highest angels are sent to care for the world that was once among the darkest.
p027.s0.b3: The framework of the paper is seven orders of service. Yet ascenders meet them in the reverse order of their naming: the Paradise career begins with the instigators of rest and the training ends with the conductors of worship, after which the endless career of the finaliter begins. The sections of the paper follow this order of experience.

p027.s1.h: I. Instigators of Rest — The Sleep That Crosses into Eternity
p027.s1.b0: The instigators of rest go out to the innermost circuit of Havona and work there with the complements of rest of the secondary supernaphim. They are the final instructors who make ready the pilgrims of time for eternity, and they preside over the last transition sleep that graduates a creature of space into the realm of the eternal.

p027.s1.b1.q: The one essential to the enjoyment of Paradise is rest, divine rest

p027.s1.b2: The section explains that rest is sevenfold. Among its forms, the deep sleep of metamorphosis is of a different kind. It is not progress through the stages of one status but the transition sleep that attends every real change of universe status.

p027.s1.b4: The last metamorphic sleep means more than all the earlier transition slumbers that marked the status attainments of the ascending career. Through it the creature crosses the innermost margins of time and space to take up residence on timeless and spaceless Paradise. Just as seraphim are essential to a mortal’s survival of death, the instigators and complements of rest are essential to this transcending metamorphosis. At every great transition of life, someone’s care is present, and this pattern binds together the beginning and the end of the ascent.
p027.s1.b5: The pilgrim who fell asleep on the last circuit of Havona awakens on Paradise and recognizes in the instigator of rest who greets him the very angel who brought on that final sleep. And he remembers the last reach of faith in which he once more committed the keeping of his identity into the hands of the Father. Even at the last threshold of the ascent, what is asked of us is not knowledge but trust.
p027.s2.h: II. Chiefs of Assignment — Service and Fellowship
p027.s2.b0: The chiefs of assignment are the group designated by the chief of supernaphim to preside over the organization of all three orders of supernaphim. As a body the supernaphim are self-governing and self-regulating; only their common chief, the first angel of Paradise, is above them.
p027.s2.b1: The section reminds us that life on Paradise is not filled with study alone; service is an essential part of prefinaliter education. Ascenders must also fraternize with upwards of three thousand orders of Paradise Citizens and many other beings, and after long contact with such mighty intellects it is very restful to visit with angelic types of mind, which remind them of the seraphim they have known so long. That even in the highest places a conversation with a familiar kind of friend can be a rest is a very human touch.
p027.s3.h: III. Interpreters of Ethics — A Widening Circle of Associates
p027.s3.b0: The higher one ascends in the scale of life, the more attention must be paid to universe ethics. The section defines the starting point of ethics very simply.

p027.s3.b1.q: Ethical awareness is simply the recognition by any individual of the rights inherent in the existence of any and all other individuals.

p027.s3.b2: From the world of origin onward, the ascender has added one group of associates after another, and with each new group came one more level of ethics to observe. So by the time he reaches Paradise he does not need to learn ethics anew, but he does need counselors to help him interpret what he has learned in the presence of countless unfamiliar beings. The interpreters of ethics assist in this adjustment from the attainment of residential status until admission to the Corps of the Finality.

p027.s3.b3.q: All these celestial companionships are invariably mutual.

p027.s3.b4: The ascending mortal is not merely a guest who receives from higher beings. He imparts to them something of his own personality and experience, and they are forever made different and better for having been associated with a mortal from the evolutionary worlds. Our small and imperfect beginning turns out to be a unique gift to the universe.
p027.s4.h: IV. Directors of Conduct — Guides for the Strangers Within the Gates
p027.s4.b0: Conduct on Paradise springs not from meaningless formality or artificial caste but from inherent courtesy. All conduct is spontaneous and free, and yet there is a proper and perfect way of doing things. The directors of conduct stay beside the “⟦Q 27:4.3⟧strangers within the gates⟦/Q⟧” to guide their steps and spare them the confusion and uncertainty that would otherwise be inevitable.

p027.s4.b1.q: Proper conduct is essential to progress by way of knowledge, through philosophy, to the spiritual heights of spontaneous worship.

p027.s4.b2: Despite the long preparation and the long journey, Paradise is still inexpressibly strange and new to those who arrive. There is comfort in this admission. However well prepared we are, it is no shame to be awkward in a new setting, and guides have been provided to help us through that awkwardness.
p027.s5.h: V. The Custodians of Knowledge — A Living Library
p027.s5.b0: The custodians of knowledge are the “living epistles” read by all on Paradise. The facts of the universes are actually recorded in them, and it is inherently impossible for an untruth to lodge in their minds. Ask the living finders of knowledge at the northern extremity of the Isle, and the very beings who are what you wish to know will appear. Instead of engrossed pages, one learns face to face with living intelligences.

p027.s5.b1.q: They are the divine records of truth, the living books of real knowledge.

p027.s5.b2: They have organized knowledge into seven grand divisions, each with about one million subdivisions. This living library, however, is available only to the central universe and the superuniverses; the local universes benefit from it only indirectly, by reflection. That is why time and space require their own vast organization of recording angels.

p027.s5.b3.q: The wisdom of truth takes origin in the divinity of the central universe, but knowledge, experiential knowledge, largely has its beginnings in the domains of time and space

p027.s6.h: VI. Masters of Philosophy — Mysteries That Never End

p027.s6.b0.q: Next to the supreme satisfaction of worship is the exhilaration of philosophy.

p027.s6.b1: However high we climb, a thousand mysteries will remain that call for philosophy. The masters of philosophy, the “⟦Q 27:6.2⟧wise men of heaven,⟦/Q⟧” use the truth of knowledge and the facts of experience to master the unknown, and at the southern extremity of Paradise they conduct courses in the seventy functional divisions of wisdom. One hour of their instruction, we are told, would equal ten thousand years of Urantia’s word-memory methods.
p027.s6.b2: Placed side by side, sections five and six reveal the ladder of learning this paper describes: not stopping at knowing facts, but threading them into truth and raising experience into wisdom. The conclusions of philosophy cannot be as settled as facts, yet those who hear the masters find lasting satisfaction even before unsolved questions. These teachings are not broadcast; only those present can receive them.

p027.s7.h: VII. Conductors of Worship — Worship That Overflows

p027.s7.b0.q: Worship is the highest privilege and the first duty of all created intelligences.

p027.s7.b1: Worship is the conscious and joyous act of recognizing the intimate, personal relationship between the Creators and their creatures, and its quality is determined by the depth of creature perception. As pilgrims pass through the Havona circuits, worship becomes an ever-growing passion, until on Paradise its expression must actually be directed. Were it not for the chiefs of assignment periodically breaking up the assemblies, ascenders would remain forever in the attitude of worship. We can only guess at a place where worship has passed beyond duty into delight.

p027.s7.b2.q: What play does for your jaded minds on earth, worship will do for your perfected souls on Paradise.

p027.s7.b3: Interestingly, beings of inherent perfection can never fully appreciate the spiritual emotions of those who have slowly climbed up from the depths of darkness. So since the times of Grandfanda the supernaphim have never been able fully to accommodate the spirit of worship on Paradise. The insight here is that the gratitude of those who rose through struggle becomes the greatest worship. When the fullness of worship is reached, the ascender is ready for the seventh jubilee.

Then the finaliter stands before eternal service and the new challenge of God the Ultimate. The paper tells us that we can begin to appreciate the spirit of Paradise worship even here on Urantia, because the spirits of the Gods already indwell us.

p028.s0.b0: If the supernaphim are the angels of the central universe and the seraphim the angels of the local universes, the **seconaphim** are the ministering spirits of the superuniverses. They are children of the Reflective Spirits, and in degree of divinity and potential they are much nearer the supernaphim than the seraphim. p028.s1.h: I–II. The Tertiaphim and the Omniaphim — Helpers Behind the Scenes
p028.s1.b0: When a Michael Son sets out on his universe adventure, the Infinite Spirit brings forth a corps of one thousand tertiaphim to accompany him. During the turbulent era of universe building they serve as the Creator Son’s only personal staff and gain great experience. Once the Bright and Morning Star of the local universe is personalized and the native angels appear, they retire from active duty to become liaison ministers between the Creator Son and the Ancients of Days. Those who began the work step aside and take up the task of connecting.
p028.s1.b1: The omniaphim are the exclusive servants and messengers of the Seven Supreme Executives. In Orvonton they have a courtesy colony north of Uversa, yet they are neither registered on Uversa nor part of its administration; they take direction only from the Supreme Executive of Orvonton.
p028.s2.h: III. The Seconaphim — Created in Sevens
p028.s2.b0: Seconaphim are produced in groups of seven by the seven Reflective Spirits at the headquarters of each superuniverse. Every seven always contains one primary, three secondary, and three tertiary seconaphim, an unchanging ratio, and each seven is at once divided among three levels of the supergovernment.

p028.s2.b2: Their nature is **reflectivity**. They respond reflectively to everything that originates in the Third Source and Center and in the Paradise Creator Sons, but they do not directly reflect beings of sole origin in the First Source and Center. The author says that even without any other proof, the reflective performances of the seconaphim would suffice to demonstrate the real presence of the infinite mind of the Conjoint Actor throughout the universe.
p028.s3.h: IV. The Primary Seconaphim — Living Mirrors of the Ancients of Days
p028.s3.b0: The primary seconaphim are living mirrors serving the Ancients of Days. By turning to such a mirror, they can instantly and unerringly see and hear the response of a being tens of thousands of light-years away. The superuniverse rulers, standing midway between man and God, thus know both what is above and what is below, and each superuniverse stays in close touch with the central universe and Paradise.

p028.s3.b1.q: The seven supergovernments, though individually segregated, are thus perfectly reflective of the authority above and are wholly sympathetic, as well as perfectly conversant, with the needs below.

When the Ancients of Days wish to know the attitude of Michael of Nebadon, they need not call him over the lines of space; they perceive his voice through a registered seconaphim. The author admits that he does not fully understand how this is done, but says that it certainly works.

p028.s3.b4.q: in all the history of Uversa the secoraphic voices have never erred in their presentations.

p028.s3.b5: The Ancients of Days deduce the Father’s will by equating the Spirit voice from above with the Michael voices from below. But to deduce the will of one God from knowledge of the other two, all three Ancients of Days must act together, and that is why the superuniverses are always presided over by three. The principle that no one alone can reach a complete judgment is written into the very structure of universe government.

p028.s4.b2: Among these, the Union of Souls deals with the petty frictions and minor misunderstandings that arise in commerce and trade, friendship and marriage. The observation that even trivial misunderstandings, if allowed to multiply, mar the smooth working of the universe applies just as well to our daily relationships.

p028.s4.b3.q: One of the most important lessons to be learned during your mortal career is teamwork.

p028.s4.b4: The Joy of Existence seeks to show that there is joy in free-will existence itself, whatever the outward conditions. The Discerner of Spirits reveals the true motive and nature of any information and even reflects the presence of Adjusters. Yet the paper is clear about a limit: the content of the minds of the Mystery Monitors cannot be deciphered.

p028.s4.b5.q: It should, however, be mentioned that the knowledge and plans of the Father fragments are not reflectible.

p028.s5.b2: The Memory of Mercy is a living trial balance that sets each person’s spiritual account against the saving credit established by the Sons of God. If we are sincere of purpose and honest of heart, our drawing credits always far exceed our ability to exhaust them. Mercy, however, is not thrust upon those who despise it. The paper teaches that mercy is not a feeling that appears all at once but a quality that grows through stages.

p028.s5.b5: Time is the one universal endowment of all will creatures, and it is fatally squandered only when it is buried in neglect and not used to make certain the survival of the soul. Failing to make the most of one’s time brings no fatal penalty; it merely delays the pilgrim.

p028.s5.b6.q: If survival is gained, all other losses can be retrieved.

p028.s5.b7.q: Trustworthiness is the true measure of self-mastery, character.

p028.s5.b8: Our superiors advance us with greater trusts just as fast as our character can bear them, for overloading a person too early only courts disaster. Once trustworthiness is found, the privilege of service follows, and it is purposeful service, not slavery. And the paper states plainly that this universe was not made just for us.

p028.s5.b9.q: This is not an egocentric universe.

p028.s5.b10: The last two types always work together. Greatness cannot be estimated without knowing the content of goodness, and goodness cannot be portrayed without exhibiting its divine greatness. On a world like Urantia greatness shows itself as self-control, and to the extent that we become good through grace, we are becoming great.

p028.s5.b11.q: To be great is to be Godlike.

p028.s6.h: VII. Ministry of the Seconaphim — Guideposts at the Crossroads of Time
p028.s6.b0: The seconaphim range from the shores of Paradise to the evolutionary worlds, and they teach ascenders on the four hundred ninety study worlds surrounding Uversa, the finishing schools of the universes of time that prepare pilgrims for Havona. The tertiary seconaphim in particular are timesavers, error detectors, faithful teachers, and living guideposts placed at the crossroads of time to guide the feet of anxious pilgrims.
p028.s6.b1: Urantia, however, is still under partial spiritual quarantine, and these angels cannot function freely here because some of the reflective circuits are absent. The author says that even under these restrictions they go on joyfully with the means at hand. That attitude—doing gladly what can be done even when conditions are not ideal—is the last impression the paper leaves.
p028.s7.b0: Paper 28 looks like a classification of angels, but within it is a map of character. What the seconaphim reflect—wisdom and teamwork, joy and service, mercy and time, trust and greatness—are qualities we can begin to learn here and now. The universe reflects these qualities as in a mirror, and before that mirror words cannot hide our motives.

p029.s1.h: I. The Seven Supreme Power Directors — Semimaterial Beings Born of Spirit
p029.s1.b0: The Seven Supreme Power Directors are the regulators of physical energy in the grand universe. Their creation by the Seven Master Spirits is the first record of semimaterial offspring coming from truly spirit ancestry. When the Master Spirits create individually they produce spirit personalities of the angelic orders; when they create collectively, they sometimes produce such semimaterial beings.
p029.s1.b1: The seven directors are identical in appearance and function, and no one but the Master Spirit with whom each is associated can tell them apart. The same director is always paired with the same Spirit, and their collaboration is a unique association of physical and spiritual energy. Spirit and matter, we see here, are not distant realms but were designed from the start to work together.

p029.s1.b2.q: The physical creation is fundamentally uniform in administration.

p029.s2.b0: The Supreme Power Directors cannot reproduce themselves alone, but collectively, in union with the Master Spirits, they create the power centers. These are beings of high will and exquisite intelligence, with personality of the Third Source, and they are the secret of the mind control of the vast network of physical controllers. p029.s2.b3.q: Perfection of energy regulation is the ultimate goal of all the power centers and the physical controllers of space.

p029.s2.b4: The power charge of a superuniverse consists of three energy streams of ten segregations each, like a vast ocean of energy that bathes all seven supercreations. Within that ocean the specialized currents sent out by the power centers are sharply defined local movements of energy, like the Gulf Stream in the midst of the Atlantic.
p029.s2.b5: The local universe centers can lay down energy lanes, reinforced channels for communication between important inhabited points. These are individualized currents running from one power center to another, unlike undifferentiated energy moving through free space. Local astronomic catastrophes in space are only of passing interest to them; they concentrate on the orderly delivery of available energy to the subordinate constellations and systems. Their steadiness, keeping their currents flowing amid great upheaval, is striking.
p029.s3.h: III. The Domain of Power Centers — Tireless Workers
p029.s3.b0: The power centers and their subordinates number more than ten billion, all perfectly synchronized with the Seven Supreme Power Directors on Paradise. They are exempt from the restraint of any tribunal and are not subject to the direction of the superuniverse governments or the local universe administrations. Yet in some way they are closely related to the cosmic overcontrol of the Supreme Being.

Relation to gravity
Only to resist its pull — wholly negative

p029.s3.b3: The universal scheme makes no provision for interrupting the physical lines of energy, so these beings can never for a moment relinquish their supervision. Knowing that such unceasing faithfulness lies behind the stability of the physical world we take for granted gives us reason for gratitude.
p029.s3.b4: The forms of energy beyond their control represent the unpredictable realm of the Unqualified Absolute. The centers and controllers exercise almost supreme authority in local situations, yet they are always conscious of the presence of the Unqualified Absolute. The author frankly says that explaining how they work is beyond his ability.

p029.s3.b5.q: They are both living and “personal,” but they are beyond your comprehension.

p029.s4.h: IV. The Master Physical Controllers — Intelligence Without Choice
p029.s4.b0: The Master Physical Controllers are the mobile subordinates of the Supreme Power Centers and serve throughout the grand universe. Up to the superuniverse headquarters they are governed by the Seven Supreme Power Directors; from there on they are directed by the equilibrium commissions. They deal chiefly with a fundamental energy not yet discovered on Urantia, one that is essential to interplanetary transport and communication.

p029.s4.b2: The philosophical heart of this section is the distinction between mind and personality. The last four orders in particular respond automatically to the impulses of their superiors, yet this is not mere mechanism; all disclose the differential function of intelligence. Still, they have no will or independence of decision. By contrast, this shows how remarkable it is for a being to receive a personality able to choose.

p029.s4.b3.q: Personality is not necessarily a concomitant of mind.

p029.s4.b4: The energy transformers insulate planets from powerful energy currents and maintain power equilibrium, but they do not function directly in the realms of life or change the forms of living beings. And three of the thirty energies are beyond their control. The physical order of the universe and the order of life interlock, yet they are not entrusted to the same hands.
p029.s4.b5: These controllers are close to the life of our own world. The ten mechanical controllers now stationed on Urantia act as one to assist the departure of the seraphic transports, and the energy transmitters provide emergency lines of communication outside the regular circuits. Transmitters and transformers are indispensable to mortal existence on worlds of meager atmosphere, and on nonbreathing planets they are an essential part of the life technique. Many unseen hands uphold the conditions of life.

p029.s4.b6.q: They are truly the alchemists of space and the wonder-workers of time.

p029.s4.b7: Yet in all their wonders the dissociators never transgress the mandates of Cosmic Supremacy. Of the frandalanks the author says that, though intelligent, they cannot be classified as anything but living machines, and he invites us to picture them by comparison with mankind’s own precision instruments.
p029.s5.h: V. The Master Force Organizers — Pioneers of Unorganized Space
p029.s5.b0: The Master Force Organizers are resident on Paradise but work chiefly in the domains of unorganized space. They are neither creators nor creatures, and they work only under the supervision of the Architects of the Master Universe. The power directors take over the work they begin, in the following sequence.

p029.s5.b3: These force organizers function under temperatures and conditions that neither power centers nor physical controllers could endure. The only other revealed beings able to act in such outer space are the Solitary Messengers and the Inspired Trinity Spirits.
p029.s6.b0: Paper 29 tells us that the physical world beneath our feet is not a machine running by itself but is held in the unceasing care of intelligent beings. A lineage that begins in spirit reaches through semimaterial beings to every single energy circuit. At the same time, by distinguishing intelligence from personality, the paper reminds us what a precious gift the ability to choose and take responsibility really is.
